授業概要
主として動物を題材とした遺伝子、種、生態系、景観の各レベルの生物多様性に関する知識を基盤に、生態系機能の調査･解析法や生態リスクの評価･予測･管理のための手法を学ぶ。夏学期は、生物多様性科学の基礎知識として生物多様性の創出機構に関する知識を学ぶ。
I explain the methodology of ecological risk evaluation for the effects of human activity on biodiversity and ecosystems. I also explain basic ideas on how to control these risks and build consensus between stakeholders. I refer to many case studies of environmental issues.

全体の教育目標
人口増加や経済発展に伴って生態系の破壊と生態系サービスの劣化が著しいアジア諸国をはじめとする地域の生態リスクの適切な管理に貢献できる専門的知識と実践力を兼ね備えた人材を育成する。
Together with the "biodiversity loss" such as a decrease in the forest, the mass extinction of wild species, and the loss of genetic variation, the basis of our human civilization continuously has been threatened. In this class, students learn about risk assessment which is indispensable for reducing the rate of biodiversity loss so as to make biodiversity sustainable.
